TAL_BEASTMASTERY_TEN_THOUSAND_BEAST_PROC.why: Procession remains an Action that expends Martial Focus once per long rest and requires concentration for up to 1 minute. Resistance to Frightened is a GM reminder; owning the talent grants no fear immunity.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_PACK_ENCIRCLEMENT.why: Two conscious Beast Allies threatening an enemy defeat its Disengage protection against those beasts only. First pack hit each round reduces Speed by 10 until target turn start; attacking a Beast Ally offers another Beast Ally within the attacker’s reach a chosen 5-foot move without Opportunity Attacks.

TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SOVEREIGN_PACK_MIND.why: Activate with a Bonus Action, expend Martial Focus, once per long rest, for 1 minute. Once per round, choose whether to add your Proficiency Bonus to one Beast Ally's attack, save or check within 120 feet after seeing the roll and before its outcome.
